tasks.label: Elmer: Run combined solver
tasks.detail: Solves the wall+foundation+bedrock three-body model with the configured interface springs. Writes a fresh run under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Lamb\three-body-solver and prints the result path. Run this first; Code_Aster: Run three-body stress analysis auto-finds its most recent output.

tasks.label: Code_Aster: Run three-body stress analysis
tasks.detail: One-command wrapper for the full Code_Aster three-body cross-check: exports the mesh from the latest Elmer: Run combined solver run, generates the .comm case, solves it against the real Salome-Meca/Code_Aster install at C:\SALOME-MECA\2025\W64\CODE_ASTER_17.4, then prints peak displacement and peak tensile/compressive stress, Elmer vs Code_Aster (Aster/results/01_three_body_baseline/comparison_report.json). Open Aster/results/01_three_body_baseline/run/result_stress.vtu in stock ParaView for stress components, principal stresses and von Mises stress (Pa). The original result.med needs a MED reader such as Salome/ParaVis; mesh.med is geometry-only.
